mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the outer and deeper layers was worthwhile because it showed how protective skin fits over living, supplied tissue.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the gland and nerve endings was clear but a little repetitive once the slots were named.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the outer layer has no blood vessels and receives supplies from the tissue beneath it.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and named slots made the pairings understandable.

continue.text: I would probably continue: connecting the skin to the body brought its different jobs together, although the slot fittings themselves were fairly predictable.
